description.narrative: The project comprises the design, construction, commissioning, operation and maintenance of a 216 MW run-of-river hydro power plant, 1.2 kilometers of transmission lines, and associated infrastructure on the Trishuli River. The electricity generated will be sold for domestic consumption to the Nepal Electricity Authority.
